nodes.name: Lead Form Submission
nodes.notes: Receives new lead submissions from the website through a POST webhook, including the lead's name, email, company name, and website.

nodes.name: Clean & Normalize Lead Data
nodes.notes: Cleans and standardizes incoming lead data, extracts the submitted fields from the webhook body, and prepares the lead information for validation and enrichment.

nodes.name: Validate Lead Data
nodes.notes: Checks that each lead contains a name, email, company name, and website. Valid leads continue to enrichment, while leads missing required information are sent to the error log in Google Sheets.

actorId.cachedResultName: Company Firmographics: Employees Industry HQ Revenue Clay (mambalabs/company-firmographic-enricher)

nodes.name: Enrich Company Details
nodes.notes: Uses the Apify company enrichment actor to look up company information from the lead's website domain and retrieve available firmographic details for lead scoring.

nodes.name: Get dataset items
nodes.notes: Retrieves the company enrichment results from the Apify dataset. If an error occurs, the workflow continues so the failure can be handled downstream rather than stopping the entire workflow immediately.

nodes.name: Log Enrichment Errors
nodes.notes: Logs leads that fail validation or encounter enrichment errors in Google Sheets, including lead details and an error message for review.

nodes.name: Merge
nodes.notes: Combines the original validated lead information with the company enrichment results from Apify, matching items by position so the lead details and company data can be used together in the next step.

nodes.name: Enrich Contact Details
nodes.notes: Uses the Apify Contact Details Scraper to scan the lead's company website for publicly available contact information, including email addresses and phone numbers. If the node encounters an execution error, the error output routes the failure to the error-log path.

nodes.name: Calculate Lead Score
nodes.notes: Calculates a score for each lead using the defined scoring rules and assigns a lead temperature, such as Hot, Warm, or Cold.

nodes.name: Create or update a contact
nodes.notes: Creates or updates a HubSpot contact using the cleaned company name and website, and saves the calculated lead score and temperature.

nodes.name: Merge1
nodes.notes: Combines the contact enrichment results with the existing lead and company information so the scoring node receives the combined data.

nodes.name: When clicking ‘Execute workflow’
nodes.notes: Manually starts the test workflow so the prepared sample leads can be sent to the main lead-processing workflow.

nodes.name: Code in JavaScript
nodes.notes: Creates 10 sample leads for testing the workflow, including 7 valid leads and 3 deliberately incomplete leads to test validation and error logging.

nodes.name: HTTP Request
nodes.notes: Sends each of the 10 test leads to the main workflow through its production webhook using HTTP POST requests, allowing the lead-processing workflow to be tested end to end.
